transcript: Nurse: How long has the patient been here? He is here since two hour... AI Avatar: Ruko. 'He has been here for two hours' bolo. Present perfect chahiye. [Wait. Say 'He has been here for two hours'. Present perfect is needed.] Nurse: He has been here for two hours. Doctor has came. AI Avatar: Doctor has come. 'Came' nahi, 'come' bolo. [Doctor has come. Say 'come', not 'came'.] Nurse: Tum itni jaldi seedha karti ho, tum kaun ho? [You correct me so quickly, who are you?] AI Avatar: Main Speak Easy ki AI coach hoon. Do galtiyan, ek minute mein theek, bina daante. [I am Speak Easy's AI coach. Two mistakes corrected in one minute, without scolding.] Nurse: Foreign patients aate hain to main doosri nurse ko bulati hoon. [When foreign patients come, I call another nurse.] AI Avatar: Ab nahi bulana padega. Roz 15 minute, ₹1 trial, jab bhi fursat ho. Ek saal aur doosron ko bulana hai ya is mahine se khud bolna shuru karna hai? [You won't have to call anyone now. 15 minutes daily, ₹1 trial, whenever you are free. Do you want to keep calling others for another year, or start speaking yourself from this month?] Nurse: Is mahine se. [From this month.] AI Avatar: To install button par click karo aur Speak Easy app download karo. [Then click the install button and download the Speak Easy app.] Presenter: Abhi Speak Easy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the Speak Easy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy. Install Now. [Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy. Install Now.]
summary: A nurse is corrected in real-time by an AI coach from the SpeakEasy app while speaking English. The AI coach promotes the app's daily 15-minute practice and ₹1 trial to help users speak English fluently without relying on others. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app.
